title: CSM scan suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority scan preferences for the csm-scan namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only retry count and output format are configurable; outputFormat is pinned to JSON so configuration can never broaden the effective NORMS write scope, and redaction, deterministic render, single-write discipline, lifecycle, credentials, and write scope are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of bounded scan retries (0-5).

outputFormat.description: Canonical output format; JSON only — Markdown stays a disposable projection.
